x: From left to right: Nigel Clarke, Jon Coy, Mark Anderson, Brandon Reid, Gavin Teahan, Colin Bond and Tony Stone.

The Senior Men were led through the first lap by Nigel Clarke in a fairly modest time but the field began to stretch down the back straight when efforts came from Australian Brandon Reid and New Zealanders Gavin Teahan and Mark Anderson.

Belgrave came second in the Surrey team race helped by some very encouraging performances from a fit again Andy Paton (5th in the Surrey Champs.), Marcello Bizio (6th), Mark Anderson and Brandon Reid.
Brandon Reid was the early surprise with an excellent 16:26. He did have good reason to run well as his family, over here on holiday from Australia, turned up to watch him run.

Graham Adams was back home from the US for a short while and called in for Brandon Reid's farewell/Jackie Stone's 21st birthday party. Graham will be back to the states soon and then hopes to get to New Zealand and 'Oz'.

We had sadly missed our key men all season and again Gary Staines, John Gladwin, Stuart Paton, Ollie Foote and Frank Ward were all still absent, added to which Ikem Billy was again injured while Steve Halliday was enjoying a 5 day prize holiday in Paris with Brandon Reid also on vacation.

Marcello Bizio and Brandon Reid both stuck gamely to the task although neither was 100% fit. 1, K.Usher (Hounslow) 24:52; 2, K.Penney (Boxhill R) 24:57; 3, D.Cowan (Boxhill R) 24:59; ... 23, J.Estall 26:19; 45, J.Ryle 26:19; 55, R.Alsop 27:16; 59, M.Webb 27:23; 63, M.Bizio 27:28; 72, M.Mazzotta 27:4…
